_comment: Default for membrane protein + ligand. 10 ns total at 4 fs (needs HMR). Lipid tails are freed early so the protein-lipid can repack; headgroups are restrained in z only, holding leaflet registry while leaving lateral diffusion and area-per-lipid free for the semi-isotropic barostat. Lipid selections default to POPC in CHARMM atom naming; edit them for other lipids.

components_lookup.protein_BB: protein and name CA C N O
components_lookup.protein_SC: protein and not name CA C N O H*
components_lookup.ligand: resname UNK and not name H*

lipid_head.selection: resname POP POPC POPE POPS DOPC DOPE DPPC DMPC and name N C11 C12 C13 C14 C15 P O11 O12 O13 O14 C1 C2 C3 O21 C21 O22 O31 C31 O32 and not name H*

components_lookup.lipid_tail: resname POP POPC POPE POPS DOPC DOPE DPPC DMPC and not name H* and not name N C11 C12 C13 C14 C15 P O11 O12 O13 O14 C1 C2 C3 O21 C21 O22 O31 C31 O32
